Rest breaks and a cheerful cycle
Our newest handler brought up a question about lighting levels, and the crew cheered
Calm Handling, Clear Air

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways continues to remind staff and travelers that careful pet care begins with steady routines and clear communication. <<FACT F053>> Please keep carriers secure, speak softly near animal areas, and watch for signs of stress during boarding and transfer.

Small details matter on every journey. <<FACT F034>> Travelers should review carrier fit, water access, and comfort before arrival, while the ground team moves each crate with care and checks every latch. When in doubt, ask early so the trip stays calm, humane, and orderly.
